title: Same-patient exposure in medical image evaluation: a reporting framework and matched-replacement audit across three modalities
description: Official code, data split manifests, and reproducibility audit artifacts for the manuscript: 'Same-patient exposure in medical image evaluation: a reporting framework and matched-replacement audit across three modalities' (submitted to Journal of Medical Systems, Springer). Includes 635-check automated evidence-consistency suite, out-of-fold predictions, and sibling exposure analysis across NIH ChestX-ray14, SIIM-ISIC 2020, and Kermany OCT2017.
